title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: Apply the answer method to Standard, Negative, Missing word(s) and List questions; recognize the most common look-alike terms; use the whole-course review sheet
the official ITIL Foundation (Version 5) syllabus, version 5.0 (February 2026)

toc.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse
The lists to know by heart

html:
1The pairs the exam likes to confuse

Pair The difference
Output / outcome deliverable / result for a stakeholder
Utility / warranty fit for purpose / fit for use
Sponsor / customer / user pays / defines needs and owns outcomes / uses
Basic / cooperative / collaborative transaction / mutual benefit / partnership
Transfer of goods / access to resources ownership passes / use without owning
Event / incident change of state / unplanned interruption
Problem / error / known error cause / fault / understood but unresolved, with workaround
Continuous delivery / deployment ready to release / released automatically
Core / enabling value stream consumer feels it / supports the core
Mapping / management shows the flow / improves it
CSF / metric must be true / how it is measured
GenAI / agentic AI creates content / acts toward a goal

2The lists to know by heart

List Items
Eight lifecycle activities discover, design, acquire, build, transition, operate, deliver, support
Five ITIL Value System components guiding principles, governance, value chain, management practices, continual improvement
Seven guiding principles focus on value; start where you are; progress iteratively with feedback; collaborate and promote visibility; think and work holistically; keep it simple and practical; optimize and automate
Four dimensions organizations and people; information and technology; partners and suppliers; value streams and processes
Seven improvement steps vision, current state, target state, how to get there, action, evaluation, momentum
Six AI capabilities creation, curation, clarification, cognition, communication, coordination
PESTLE political, economic, social, technological, legal, environmental

3Technique for each question style

Style Technique
Standard Read the last line, name the term, eliminate
Negative Rewrite as "find the false one"; check each option
Missing word(s) Read the sentence with each option; choose the definition
List Mark each statement true or false; pick the pair

Old wording alert: if an option says service value system, service value chain, plan, improve, engage, general, service and technical practices, it is ITIL 4 language and is probably a distractor for Version 5.

Exam tip

. Before you answer, ask: is this an ITIL 4 word? Service value system, service value chain, plan, improve, engage and three practice groups are old wording and rarely the right Version 5 answer.

Exam tip

. With no negative marking, answer every question; flag the hard ones and return with the time left.

4Exam Q&A: final review

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Which list names the ITIL Value System components?

  • ADiscover, design, acquire, build, transition, operate, deliver, support
  • BGuiding principles, governance, value chain, management practices, continual improvement
  • COrganizations and people, information and technology, partners and suppliers, value streams and processes
  • DVision, current state, target state, how to get there, action, evaluation, momentum
Show the answer

Answer: B. B is the lifecycle, C the dimensions, D the improvement steps.

S2A user reports that the payment page is down. Which term describes the report?

  • AService request
  • BIncident
  • CPrototype
  • DValue stream
Show the answer

Answer: B. An unplanned interruption is an incident.

S3Which statements are CORRECT? (1) Utility means fit for purpose. (2) Warranty means fit for purpose. (3) Output is a deliverable and outcome is a result. (4) A sponsor defines requirements for the service.

  • A1 and 3
  • B2 and 4
  • C1 and 4
  • D2 and 3
Show the answer

Answer: A. Utility is fit for purpose, and output is a deliverable while outcome is a result.

S4Identify the missing word(s). A [ ? ] is a problem that has been analyzed but not resolved, usually with a workaround.

  • ARelease
  • BEvent
  • CService level
  • DKnown error
Show the answer

Answer: D. That is a known error.

S5Which principle says to improve a process before automating it?

  • AStart where you are
  • BFocus on value
  • CThink and work holistically
  • DOptimize and automate
Show the answer

Answer: D. Optimize first, then automate.

S6A team draws the steps, waits and handoffs of its order process to see where work slows. What is this?

  • AGovernance
  • BA service level agreement
  • CValue stream mapping
  • DContinuous deployment
Show the answer

Answer: C. Drawing steps and waits is value stream mapping.

S7Which statement about the lifecycle activities is CORRECT?

  • AThey must be completed once, in strict order
  • BThey are the same as the ITIL 4 six-activity service value chain
  • CThey apply only to physical goods
  • DThey are not sequential or linear and can be used iteratively
Show the answer

Answer: D. The activities loop and can be iterated.

S8How many marks do you need to pass?

  • A24
  • B28
  • C26
  • D30
Show the answer

Answer: C. The pass mark is 26 of 40.

S9Which capability of the ITIL AI Capability Model covers natural interaction such as chat and voice?

  • ACognition
  • BCommunication
  • CCuration
  • DCoordination
Show the answer

Answer: B. Communication is natural interaction.

4.2 Recall questions

R1What is the pass mark?

Show the answer

26 of 40 (65 percent).

R2Which category has the highest weight?

Show the answer

The ITIL Value System, at 40 percent.

R3Name the eight lifecycle activities.

Show the answer

Discover, design, acquire, build, transition, operate, deliver, support.

R4Name the seven guiding principles.

Show the answer

Focus on value; start where you are; progress iteratively with feedback; collaborate and promote visibility; think and work holistically; keep it simple and practical; optimize and automate.

R5What is the ITIL 4 name for the ITIL Value System?

Show the answer

The service value system.

R6What is the difference between governance and management?

Show the answer

Governance directs and controls (evaluate, direct, monitor); management runs the day-to-day work.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Exam 40 questions, 60 minutes, 26 to pass, no negative marking
Weights key terms 30, dimensions 10, lifecycle 10, Value System 40, value streams 5, AI 2.5, frameworks 2.5
Method keyword, name the term, eliminate, choose the definition
Old wording service value system, six-activity value chain, three practice groups
Always answer every question
